beats.evidence: Africa is about 14 times the size of Greenland.
Greenland is 2.166 million km²; Africa is 30.37 million km².
US 9.867M + China 9.597M + India 3.287M = 22.75M km², less than Africa's 30.37M km². [computed from the cited figures]
The Mercator projection was introduced by Gerardus Mercator in 1569.
On the Mercator projection, lines of constant bearing are straight lines, but area is distorted.
Because Africa straddles the equator its Mercator size stays nearly true, while areas far from the equator are enlarged.
Framing, opinion, instruction or story; no factual claim.
